brotlidecpy 1.0.3 (pure-Python Brotli decoder) by Sidney Markowitz, MIT license (see LICENSE).
Source: https://github.com/sidney/brotlidecpy (master branch, fetched 2026-10-08). Included unmodified because FanFicFare's
browser-cache support needs a Brotli decoder and Calibre does not ship one. Bundled into the fanfic plugin by build_plugins.py.
